name: fana-deploy-openclaw
description: OpenClaw agent adapter and tool schema for fana-deploy on Alpine Linux aarch64
invariants: Never kill or modify skripsi viewer on port 8080 (skripsi.fmo.qzz.io)
Always run composer, npm, and migrations under /home/fana-deploy/deployment/run/heavy.lock
Enforce SQLite WAL mode and reject MySQL, Postgres, Redis, and Horizon
Always run cache-clearing barrier after release changes

tools.name: fana_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a new Laravel application from git with atomic symlink, SQLite WAL setup, and Caddy ingress
tools.command: /home/fana-deploy/fana-deploy deploy {{git_url}} {%- if app_name %} as {{app_name}}{%- endif %} {%- if domain %} domain {{domain}}{%- endif %}

tools.name: fana_update
tools.description: Pull latest git commits for an existing app, build under heavy lock, and atomically swap release symlink

tools.name: fana_rollback
tools.description: Rollback an application to its previous release directory

tools.name: fana_status
tools.description: Query health audit and list of active applications, or inspect detailed status of a specific app

app_name.description: Optional application slug for detailed status

tools.name: fana_logs
tools.description: Tail the last 50 lines of Caddy access logs or Laravel storage logs for an application

tools.name: fana_restart
tools.description: Restart FrankenPHP web server with memory limits and clear PHP opcode cache

tools.name: fana_backup
tools.description: Create a manual snapshot backup of an application SQLite database

tools.name: fana_restore
tools.description: Restore an application SQLite database from a backup file

backup_file.description: Full path to historical backup .sqlite file

tools.name: fana_remove
tools.description: Decommission and remove an application, archiving its database and removing tunnel ingress

tools.name: fana_list
tools.description: List all active applications, domains, current releases, and statuses

tools.name: fana_audit
tools.description: Execute system health check auditing RAM, swap, disk space, and core process health
